data.title: The Golf Residence
data.about:
Welcome to The Golf Residence by Fortimo, a luxurious residential haven within the prestigious Dubai Hills Estate. Offering a selection of exquisite 1, 2, and 3 bedroom apartments, this new 13-storey residential development embodies luxury and sophistication. 

With a rich Swiss legacy of property development excellence, Fortimo brings its unparalleled expertise and unwavering dedication to craft an exceptional living experience in Dubai. Indulge in a new standard of living where tranquillity meets luxury, as every aspect of this architectural marvel has been meticulously designed to provide residents with an unparalleled lifestyle. From contemporary design seamlessly blended with timeless elegance to meticulously crafted interiors, each detail is thoughtfully curated to ensure a life of grandeur and comfort. Discover a world where luxury knows no bounds, and experience the epitome of refined living at The Golf Residence.

The Golf Residence by Fortimo is more than just a home; it’s an experience of luxury living. Immerse yourself in a lifestyle of indulgence, where every comfort and convenience is at your fingertips. Revel in the serenity of the lush surroundings, stroll along the landscaped pathways, or engage in a game of golf at the nearby championship golf course – the choices for recreation are endless. Embrace a life where luxury meets tranquillity, and let The Golf Residence become your haven of serenity in the heart of Dubai. Experience the epitome of refined living, where every aspect of your comfort and well-being has been meticulously considered to create an unparalleled residential retreat. Live life in extraordinary splendor at The Golf Residence by Fortimo. Welcome home.

location_tile.title: Nestled Within The Prestigious Dubai Hills Estate.
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
The Fortimo Golf Residence beckons you to discover an exquisite living experience that seamlessly blends natural beauty with urban convenience. This exclusive community, situated in the heart of Dubai, is a true oasis of serenity and sophistication. Envision waking up to breathtaking views of the verdant fairways of the golf course, a captivating panorama that surrounds you with tranquillity and elegance. Immerse yourself in a world of lush greenery as meticulously landscaped parks and gardens create a tapestry of colours and scents that enchant the senses. Serene lakes mirror the azure skies, inviting you to stroll along their shores, indulging in moments of peace and reflection.

More than just a residence, this exclusive address presents a sophisticated and easy lifestyle. Imagine waking up to the soothing sounds of nature, spending leisurely afternoons amidst lush greenery, or simply relishing the embrace of luxury in your elegantly appointed home. Fortimo, The Golf Residence, promises an exquisite living experience where every moment is filled with the essence of luxury and charm. Savour the pleasures of a life well-lived as you revel in the harmonious blend of natural beauty and urban vibrancy. Come home to Fortimo The Golf Residence, where dreams meet reality, and luxury knows no bounds. Experience a world of unrivalled elegance and create unforgettable memories in an enchanting haven that celebrates the art of living. Your journey to the epitome of refined living awaits.

  • 3 MIN – KINGS COLLEGE HOSPITAL
  • 5 MIN – KINGS SCHOOL ALBARSHA
  • 5 MIN – GEMS WELLINGTON ACADEMY
  • 10 MIN – DUBAI HILLS MALL
  • 14 MIN – DUBAI DOWNTOWN
  • 20 MIN – DUBAI INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT
